name: Echo DCS-2500T
blurb: Battery top-handle. Echo's chart: 12″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 45 drive links (91PXL45CQ).
intro: The DCS-2500T is a battery top-handle saw. Echo's Bars and Chains chart lists one row: bar 12A0CD3745C, 45 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile, chain 91PXL45CQ, 5/32″ file. The catalog does not print a displacement for it.

bars.note: Echo bar 12A0CD3745C; chain 91PXL45CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. The only DCS-2500T row in Echo's bars chart.
